transitions.actions: Force all command outputs OFF; clear busy, step_wait, automatic phase to AUTO_IDLE, next_step=1; retain selected mode; Start edge memory still updates.
Sequence reset; manual combinational control enabled on later scans.

transitions.guard: EmergencyStop=TRUE AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)
transitions.actions: Sequence reset; wait for a fresh Start rising edge from top-left pose.

transitions.guard: EmergencyStop AND ManualMode AND (modeChanged OR state != MANUAL)
transitions.actions: Reset automatic sequence and latches; if modeChanged, suppress all outputs for this invocation; new mode accepted next scan.

transitions.guard: EmergencyStop AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode) AND (modeChanged OR state = MANUAL)
transitions.actions: Reset automatic sequence and latches; if modeChanged, suppress all outputs for this invocation; wait for Start.

transitions.guard: NOT (ManualMode OR SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)
transitions.actions: Reset sequence and latches; force all outputs OFF.

transitions.guard: EmergencyStop AND !modeChanged AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode) AND StartRise AND UpLimitSwitch AND LeftLimitSwitch
transitions.actions: busy=true; step_wait=false; next_step=2; begin automatic DOWN1.

transitions.guard: EmergencyStop AND SingleStepMode AND !modeChanged AND StartRise AND (next_step != 1 OR (UpLimitSwitch AND LeftLimitSwitch))
EmergencyStop AND !modeChanged AND matching completion feedback
transitions.actions: Apply mode_completion_rules; at most one automatic phase transition per scan, except continuous LEFT completion wraps once directly to DOWN1.
Ignore Start for transitions; Start edge history still updates in scan stage 1.

mode_completion_rules: SingleStepMode: on matching completion, set busy=false, step_wait=true, next_step=successor(action), and force all command intents OFF; the next action requires a fresh Start rising edge on a later scan.
SingleCycleMode: on matching completion, move to successor; LEFT completion returns to AUTO_IDLE with busy=false and all outputs OFF.
ContinuousMode: on matching completion, move to successor; LEFT completion wraps directly to DOWN1 in the same scan with busy=true.
If an already-active next-state limit/feedback is TRUE, its command is suppressed in that scan but completion is processed on the next invocation.

timer_plan.reset_conditions: Not applicable; no IEC timers are used. Start is handled by rising-edge memory; motion completion is by limit/feedback switches. Any future debounce/monitoring timer must be called unconditionally in scan stage 3 and reset when its raw input is FALSE.

priorities: 1. EmergencyStop=FALSE: force all six outputs OFF, cancel busy/automatic sequence/step wait, retain selected mode; Start edge memory still updates.
2. No selected mode or more than one selected mode: force all outputs OFF and reset the sequence; caller contract supplies mutually exclusive mode inputs.
3. Mode change after first scan: clear sequence/latches and force all outputs OFF for that invocation; edge memories still update; the new mode takes effect on subsequent scans.
4. Matching limit/feedback immediately suppresses its own command in the same scan.
5. Opposed axis commands and grip/release are mutually exclusive; opposing manual buttons inhibit both commands.

6. Manual mode is combinational: command = selected manual mode AND safe AND !modeChanged AND button AND !opposing-button AND !matching-limit. Releasing the button or reaching the limit removes the command; non-opposing manual actions may run together.
7. A fresh Start rising edge starts automatic action 1 only from top-left pose (UpLimitSwitch AND LeftLimitSwitch); Start edges during active actions are ignored.
8. Single-step completion waits for a fresh Start; single-cycle stops at LEFT and returns to AUTO_IDLE; continuous wraps LEFT to DOWN1.
scan_execution_order: 1. Edge sampling: sample all inputs into I[k]; compute StartRise = Start AND NOT start_mem; compute modeChanged = (selected_mode != mode_prev) except first_scan; update start_mem, mode_prev, first_scan. Do not change outputs here.

2. Safety/reset priority and state transitions: apply EmergencyStop, no/invalid mode, and modeChanged resets first; then evaluate manual/auto state transitions and automatic phase completion using the retained pre-state and sampled inputs; allow at most one automatic phase transition per scan, except continuous LEFT completion wraps once directly to DOWN1.

3. Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF: no timer FBs are required; if any debounce/monitoring timer is added, all timer instances are called unconditionally here every scan before output assignment.

4. Unified output assignment: compute command intents from post-transition manual/auto state; apply EmergencyStop, modeChanged, no-mode, mutual-exclusion, and matching-limit/feedback gates; assign each of the six outputs exactly once.

formal_assertions.formula: G((MoveDown | MoveUp | MoveLeft | MoveRight | ActivateGrip | ActivateRelease) -> (ManualMode | SingleStepMode | SingleCycleMode | ContinuousMode))
